note: What scripts/capture.mjs records off a booted emulator. Coordinates are for a 1080 x 2400 screen at 420 dpi, which is what `./run.sh --emulator` boots; a screenshot is 1:1 with input taps, so `node scripts/capture.mjs --probe` is how to re-read them when a screen moves. `setup` runs before the recorder starts, `steps` run while it is rolling.
